text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias and fairness. If the data used to train AI is not balanced, the system may treat some groups unfairly. Privacy is another serious concern, because AI often collects and analyses personal information. People also need transparency, which means they should understand how AI reaches its decisions. Finally, responsible AI development requires companies and governments to work together and create clear rules. This way, we can enjoy the benefits of AI while protecting people's rights and building trust in technology.
